review_candidates.title: HR Director, Retail
review_candidates.description: Be part of a movement that moves the world At ASICS, we’re more than just a brand; we're a movement. A movement of movement, propelled by the belief that motion strengthens the body and uplifts the mind. Our name itself, an acronym for "Anima Sana in Corpore Sano" (a Sound Mind in a Sound Body), encapsulates this commitment. Since taking our first step in Japan in 1949, our journey has been about more than just reaching the finish lines or clocking the fastest times. It's about the joy of moving and it's open to all. If you're inspired to move yourself and the world toward a brighter, more inclusive future, we're looking for you. Here at ASICS, we welcome diversity in our people, their backgrounds and life experiences. So, you could be the right person for this role regardless of your age, nationality, religious beliefs, or gender identification. Your role in our shared journey Based at our EMEA headquarters in Hoofddorp, near Amsterdam, you will own the HR agenda for ASICS's retail business across Europe. This is a new, dedicated role created to give our growing retail organisation the strategic HR partnership it deserves - someone who can co-create the three-year retail people strategy with the VP HR, build the HR infrastructure to support it, and partner closely with our Retail Leadership Team on everything from talent and performance to employee relations and change. This is a genuine build opportunity. ASICS Europe is investing in retail: new stores, new markets, new ambitions, and the HR infrastructure to support that growth is yours to shape. You will bring consistency and clarity to people practices across our EMEA retail markets, working through a matrix of country HR Retail Advisors and with one direct report based in Hoofddorp. With a lean team and broad scope, you will need to be as comfortable rolling up your sleeves as you are setting the strategic direction. If you are energised by building from the ground up, earning trust through results, and leaving a real mark on a growing retail business, then this is the role for you. Your Key Responsibilities Will Be Retail People Strategy - co-create the three-year EMEA retail HR strategy with the VP HR; develop and roll out retail-specific HR toolkits, programmes and practices that translate business objectives into practical people outcomes across all markets. Strategic Business Partnering - serve as a trusted partner and coach to the Retail Leadership Team on all people matters; lead HR support for growth, transformation and change initiatives across the EMEA retail estate. Matrix Leadership & Team Development - directly manage the HR Retail Manager in Hoofddorp; align and inspire country HR Retail Advisors across EMEA through influence, not hierarchy, to deliver consistent people practices across markets. Employee Relations & Compliance - own complex ER matters across EMEA retail jurisdictions; ensure compliance with employment legislation across countries; lead restructures, consultations and works council or union engagement where applicable. Talent Management & Leadership Development - lead retail talent calibration, succession planning and capability-building; partner with L&D on retail-specific learning and development initiatives designed for store populations. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning — partner with TA on retail recruitment strategy; drive initiatives to improve candidate quality, speed of hiring and retention; support store openings and retail transformation projects. You Have The Following Skills And Experience 10+ years in HR - with experience as a senior HRBP or HR Director in a multi-country international environment. Retail HR expertise - with proven experience in a multi-site retail or consumer-facing business; understands store operations, seasonal workforce dynamics and field-facing ER complexity. Track record of building or harmonising HR practice across countries - toolkits, policy frameworks, change programmes; has run restructures, store closures or works council consultations. Experienced in influence-without-authority leadership - drives results through country partners and matrix teams without relying on direct headcount. Strong EMEA employment law knowledge across at least one to two European jurisdictions; experienced with multi-country ER risk and restructure consultation. Comfortable setting strategy and personally delivering it - not dependent on a large team to execute; energised by being an individual contributor at Director level. Strong stakeholder credibility at senior commercial level - able to coach and challenge Retail Directors and Country Managers on people matters with confidence. Life at ASICS When you join ASICS, you become part of something special. Here, your voice matters, your growth and wellbeing are important. We believe in fostering an environment where every step forward is celebrated, where diversity fuels our journey, and inclusion strengthens individuals. And together and as individuals we can inspire more people to move for body and for mind. Our Commitment To Your Wellbeing We're dedicated to ensuring that every team member experiences the joy and benefits of movement. To support your wellbeing, we offer: Access to office gym and sports membership discount. Exclusive 50% discount on ASICS gear. Unlimited access to the Calm app for better sleep and mental fitness. Complimentary premium subscription to our Runkeeper Go™ app. A comprehensive wellness programme consisting of exercise and educational sessions. Professional support and meditation classes are available through OpenUp Access. Working abroad for four weeks every year. Hybrid working model. Combine the flexibility of working from home with the dynamic energy of an office environment. How To Apply Are you feeling inspired? We'd love to hear from you. Submit your application online and step into a role where you can truly make a difference. Let's move together, step by step, toward an uplifted world. #ASICShiring #ASICScareers

Since its inception, Cogent has unleashed the benefits of IP technology, building one of the largest and highest capacity IP networks in the world. This network enables Cogent to offer large bandwidth connections at highly competitive prices. Cogent also offers superior customer support by virtue of its end-to-end control of service delivery and network monitoring. Position Overview The Global Account Manager is responsible for identifying and securing new business opportunities globally. By employing consultative selling techniques and relationship-building strategies, you will work directly with the nation’s leading IT Decision Makers to position Cogent's connectivity solutions. This role involves proactive outreach through direct calling, email, and onsite meetings, with a strong focus on understanding clients' current and future connectivity needs. Success in this position will be measured by meeting or exceeding monthly revenue goals and establishing Cogent as a trusted partner across commercial and retail buildings, carrier-neutral hotels, data centers, and colocation facilities. Responsibilities Identify, qualify, and secure new business opportunities within a global sales territory, focusing on market segments who require IP transit, Wave connectivity, Ethernet, Colocation and IPv4 services. Use direct calling, email outreach, and customer meetings to connect with Key Decision Makers and generate new business opportunities. Employ consultative and relationship-driven sales approaches to identify prospective clients’ current and future connectivity needs. Position Cogent’s services as the preferred choice by leveraging our extensive global network footprint, which spans commercial and retail buildings, carrier-neutral hotels, data centers, and colocation facilities. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure customer needs are met and expectations exceeded. Maintain and update detailed records of sales activities in CRM systems, tracking progress, and managing customer relationships. Qualifications Minimum 7 years of professional experience in the telecommunications industry, including a strong background in B2B sales and business development. Proven ability to identify, qualify, and generate new business opportunities through proactive prospecting and research. Strong communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to engage effectively with Key Decision Makers. Self-motivated, positive, and proactive, with a passion for adding value to clients and excelling in a competitive, revenue-driven environment. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, team-oriented and competitive environment with revenue-driven goals and rewards. Familiarity with CRM systems and basic proficiency in Microsoft Office are beneficial. Strong understanding of the telecommunications market, Cogent’s product portfolio, and connectivity solutions including IP transit, Wave, Ethernet, Colocation and IPv4 services. Fluency in French and English is required, together with a third language, such as Polish or Russian, to support customer relationships and business development across Eastern European markets. Work Environment This is an in-office position, five days a week, designed to support your success through focused mentorship, training, and personal coaching. To apply for the Global Account Manager position, please submit your resume and cover letter to careers@cogentco.com . Cogent Communications is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

review_candidates.description: Company Description MY NONU (MyNonu.com) is an IT company that helps clients build a strong online presence and brand identity, with a particular focus on social media growth. Based in Meerut, the team supports businesses in expanding their digital reach and engaging more effectively with their audiences. In addition to IT and branding services, MY NONU offers complimentary grocery delivery, combining technology-driven solutions with everyday convenience. The company emphasizes access to quality products at affordable prices, promoting healthier lifestyles for its customers. Team members join a growing organization that values innovation, service, and customer-focused solutions. Role Description The Executive Assistant role at MY NONU is a full-time remote position that supports senior leadership in managing daily operations and strategic priorities. This role includes calendar management, scheduling meetings, organizing virtual events, and coordinating communications across internal teams and external partners. The Executive Assistant will prepare and maintain expense reports, track key deadlines, and ensure follow-up on action items from meetings. Responsibilities also include drafting and reviewing professional correspondence, handling confidential information with discretion, and providing general administrative support such as document preparation and digital file organization. The successful candidate will help streamline workflows, anticipate needs, and enable executives to focus on high-impact activities. Qualifications Strong executive administrative assistance and general administrative assistance skills, including calendar management, scheduling, and document organization. Experience with executive support and handling confidential information, ensuring timely follow-up and efficient coordination of leadership activities. Ability to prepare, track, and reconcile expense reports with attention to detail and accuracy. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact professionally with diverse stakeholders. Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., email, spreadsheets, documents, video conferencing platforms). Proven ability to work independently in a remote environment, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple deadlines. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a proactive and solutions-oriented approach. Previous experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similar administrative role; experience in IT or digital services is an advantage. Relevant education or training in business administration, management, or a related field is beneficial.
